activity.overview: Listen to a story about Kai. Tell what Kai wears in different weather.
activity.passage: Kai looks out the window. Snow is falling! Kai puts on a warm coat, a hat and mittens. The next day, the sun is hot. Kai puts on shorts and a sun hat. Kai brings a bottle of water. Clothes help us stay warm, dry or cool.

questions.prompt: What did Kai wear in the snow?
What did Kai wear when the sun was hot?
Why did Kai bring water on the hot day?
How do mittens help on a snowy day?

activity.subject: science
activity.title: What Will Kai Wear?
